title: Enthusiasm
subtitle: 「熱情／熱忱／興奮期待」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「熱情／熱忱／興奮期待」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 當 enthusiasm 強調情緒上的高漲、期待和興奮時很自然。
words.example: The children could hardly contain their excitement about the trip.
words.exampleZh: 孩子們對這次旅行興奮得幾乎按捺不住。

exercises.original: The children showed great enthusiasm when they heard about the school trip.
exercises.zh: 孩子們聽到學校旅行的消息時表現得非常興奮。
exercises.upgrade: The children showed great excitement when they heard about the school trip.

options.explanation: 聽到好消息後即時情緒高漲，最符合 excitement。
若強調「急著想出發」會更合適。
通常較深、長期，不適合一次旅行消息的即時反應。
較正式，且偏積極投入某任務或信念。
形容詞；showed great 後需要名詞。

exercises.original: There was obvious enthusiasm in the crowd before the concert began.
exercises.zh: 演唱會開始前，人群明顯非常興奮。
exercises.upgrade: There was obvious excitement in the crowd before the concert began.

options.explanation: 演出開始前的集體期待和興奮是典型用法。
也可表示期待，但較常配 to do something。
語氣更強、更正式，常帶信念或群體熱烈情緒。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm grew as the opening date approached.
exercises.zh: 隨著開幕日期接近，她愈來愈興奮。
exercises.upgrade: Her excitement grew as the opening date approached.

options.explanation: 日期愈近，期待情緒愈高。
通常不是隨日期臨近而短期增強的情緒。
更像對任務的積極投入。
是活力，不一定是期待感。

words.note: 表示很想做某事、開始某事或參與其中。
words.example: She showed great eagerness to learn.
words.exampleZh: 她表現出強烈的學習熱忱。

exercises.original: She showed great enthusiasm to begin the new course.
exercises.zh: 她非常熱切地想開始新課程。
exercises.upgrade: She showed great eagerness to begin the new course.

options.explanation: to begin 直接指很想立刻開始。
也可有期待感，但不如 eagerness 突出「想做」。
偏任務投入，不一定是開始前的急切。

exercises.original: His enthusiasm to volunteer impressed the organisers.
exercises.zh: 他熱切想當義工的態度令主辦者留下深刻印象。
exercises.upgrade: His eagerness to volunteer impressed the organisers.

options.explanation: eagerness to volunteer 是自然搭配。
也可表示投入，但通常更正式，而且較少直接用 zeal to do。
表示原因／動力，而不是熱切情緒。
可以興奮，但未必想立刻參與。

exercises.original: The students' enthusiasm to ask questions made the discussion lively.
exercises.zh: 學生們踴躍提問令討論很活躍。
exercises.upgrade: The students' eagerness to ask questions made the discussion lively.

options.explanation: 主動想提問的意願最符合。
有興趣不一定會主動提問。
強調活力，但不直接表示「很想提問」。

words.note: 表示對某件事有深厚、持久的熱愛。
words.example: His passion for music began in childhood.
words.exampleZh: 他對音樂的熱愛始於童年。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm for music has remained strong since childhood.
exercises.zh: 她從小到現在一直對音樂充滿熱愛。
exercises.upgrade: Her passion for music has remained strong since childhood.

options.explanation: since childhood 顯示長期、深厚熱愛。
更偏積極投入目標／任務。

exercises.original: He speaks about teaching with genuine enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 他談起教學時充滿真摯熱情。
exercises.upgrade: He speaks about teaching with genuine passion.

options.explanation: genuine + 對職業長期熱愛，最自然。
也可，但更像積極投入某目標。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm for animal welfare led her to work in conservation.
exercises.zh: 她對動物福利的熱愛令她投身保育工作。
exercises.upgrade: Her passion for animal welfare led her to work in conservation.

options.explanation: 足以影響人生方向，顯示深層、長期熱愛。
可能有興趣，但力度不足。
通常針對某個即將進行的行動。

words.note: 表示對目標、工作、信念或任務有強烈而積極的投入。
words.example: She approached the project with great zeal.
words.exampleZh: 她以極大的熱忱投入這個項目。

exercises.original: She approached the campaign with enormous enthusiasm and worked every evening.
exercises.zh: 她以極大的熱忱投入這項活動，每晚都工作。
exercises.upgrade: She approached the campaign with enormous zeal.

options.explanation: 持續、積極投入一項任務最符合 zeal。

exercises.original: The volunteers worked with enthusiasm to finish the project on time.
exercises.zh: 義工們充滿熱忱地工作，以準時完成項目。
exercises.upgrade: The volunteers worked with zeal to finish the project on time.

options.explanation: worked with zeal 是自然正式搭配，突出積極投入。
也可表活力，但沒有熱忱／信念意味。
也可，但通常對領域或理念更自然。

exercises.original: His enthusiasm for reform sometimes made him impatient with slower colleagues.
exercises.zh: 他對改革的熱忱有時令他對較慢的同事失去耐性。
exercises.upgrade: His zeal for reform sometimes made him impatient.

options.explanation: zeal for reform 是典型正式搭配，也可帶「過度積極」語感。
也接近，但沒有 zeal 的行動／使命感那麼強。

words.note: 表示很強烈、熱烈，甚至帶情感或信念色彩的熱情。
words.example: The supporters cheered with great fervour.
words.exampleZh: 支持者以極大的熱情歡呼。

exercises.original: The supporters cheered with extraordinary enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 支持者以極大的熱情歡呼。
exercises.upgrade: The supporters cheered with extraordinary fervour.

options.explanation: 群體熱烈情緒、強烈支持最符合。
也合理，但少了 fervour 的強烈投入感。
可行，但通常更個人化或持久。

exercises.original: She defended the cause with great enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 她以極大的熱情捍衛這項理念。
exercises.upgrade: She defended the cause with great fervour.

options.explanation: 對理念的強烈、熱烈投入很自然。
也高度接近，更偏積極行動。

exercises.original: The crowd's enthusiasm intensified as the final approached.
exercises.zh: 決賽臨近時，人群的熱烈情緒愈來愈高漲。
exercises.upgrade: The crowd's fervour intensified as the final approached.

options.explanation: 群眾支持和熱烈情緒逐步升高，正式語境自然。
也很自然，但更偏純興奮。
較持久，但未必是群體當下熱烈氣氛。

words.note: 表示強烈、真摯的熱情或投入。
words.example: He spoke about the cause with genuine ardour.
words.exampleZh: 他以真摯的熱情談論這項事業。

exercises.original: He spoke about the project with sincere enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 他以真摯的熱情談論這個項目。
exercises.upgrade: He spoke about the project with sincere ardour.

options.explanation: with sincere ardour 帶真摯、強烈投入感，較文學正式。
也很自然，但較常用、較少文學色彩。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm for the arts was obvious in everything she did.
exercises.zh: 她對藝術的熱情在一舉一動中都很明顯。
exercises.upgrade: Her ardour for the arts was obvious in everything she did.

options.explanation: 長期、真摯而強烈的熱情，語氣正式。
也高度自然，且現代使用更普遍。

exercises.original: The young researcher pursued the topic with enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 這名年輕研究員以極大熱情鑽研這個課題。
exercises.upgrade: The young researcher pursued the topic with ardour.

options.explanation: 正式、文學地表示強烈投入。
也很接近，更偏積極努力。

words.meaning: 熱衷；濃厚興趣；積極意願
words.note: 表示對某項活動很有興趣、很願意參與。
words.example: Her keenness to improve impressed the coach.
words.exampleZh: 她積極求進步的態度令教練留下深刻印象。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm to improve impressed the coach.
exercises.zh: 她積極求進步的態度令教練留下深刻印象。
exercises.upgrade: Her keenness to improve impressed the coach.

options.explanation: keenness to improve 是自然搭配，表示很有意願。
也非常接近，更強調急切。

exercises.original: The students showed enthusiasm for joining the science club.
exercises.zh: 學生們很熱衷加入科學學會。
exercises.upgrade: The students showed keenness to join the science club.

options.explanation: 表示很願意、很有興趣加入。
也很自然，且更突出急切。

exercises.original: His enthusiasm for learning new software made him a strong candidate.
exercises.zh: 他熱衷學習新軟件，令他成為很強的候選人。
exercises.upgrade: His keenness to learn new software made him a strong candidate.

options.explanation: 招聘／學習語境中很自然，表示積極願意學。
也接近，但更突出急切感。
需要改成 his keenness 或 he was keen。

words.note: 表示帶著活力、享受和積極態度投入生活或活動。
words.example: She approaches every new challenge with zest.
words.exampleZh: 她總是充滿熱情地迎接每個新挑戰。

exercises.original: She approaches every new challenge with enthusiasm and energy.
exercises.zh: 她總是充滿熱情和活力地迎接新挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: She approaches every new challenge with zest.

options.explanation: 表示活力十足、樂在其中地投入。
也有熱忱，但較任務／信念導向。

exercises.original: He returned to work with renewed enthusiasm after the holiday.
exercises.zh: 假期後，他帶著重新燃起的活力和興致回到工作。
exercises.upgrade: He returned to work with renewed zest.

options.explanation: renewed zest 很自然，帶活力與享受感。
也合理，但只表示精力充沛。
通常不是由短假期「重新恢復」的單純精力。

exercises.original: Her enthusiasm for life remained strong even in old age.
exercises.zh: 即使年老，她對生活的熱情仍然很強。
exercises.upgrade: Her zest for life remained strong even in old age.

options.explanation: zest for life 是固定而自然的表達。
也可，但 passion for life 不如 zest for life 固定。
不自然描述一般生活態度。

words.note: 當 enthusiasm 表現為積極行動、精神旺盛和投入時可接近。
words.example: He brought fresh energy to the team.
words.exampleZh: 他為團隊帶來新的活力和幹勁。

exercises.original: She brought enthusiasm and fresh ideas to the team.
exercises.zh: 她為團隊帶來活力和新想法。
exercises.upgrade: She brought fresh energy and ideas to the team.

options.explanation: 在團隊語境中表示積極幹勁和活力。
更強調對任務／使命投入。

exercises.original: The new coach gave the group renewed enthusiasm.
exercises.zh: 新教練為團隊注入新的活力。
exercises.upgrade: The new coach gave the group renewed energy.

options.explanation: renewed energy 是自然搭配，表示重新有幹勁。
可能提升熱愛，但句子重點是整體活力。
更像對目標的積極投入。
也可有興奮，但未必有持續行動力。

exercises.original: His enthusiasm helped keep the team active during the long project.
exercises.zh: 他的幹勁令團隊在漫長項目中保持活躍。
exercises.upgrade: His energy helped keep the team active during the long project.

options.explanation: keep the team active 直接指活力和幹勁。
可推動工作，但焦點較像熱愛。

words.note: 較中性、描述性地表示對某事非常有興趣。
words.example: She has a strong interest in environmental science.
words.exampleZh: 她對環境科學有濃厚興趣。

exercises.original: She has great enthusiasm for environmental science.
exercises.zh: 她對環境科學有濃厚興趣。
exercises.upgrade: She has a strong interest in environmental science.

options.explanation: 中性地表達濃厚興趣，強度比 passion 稍低。
也可，但表示更深、更持久的熱愛。
常配 to do，不是一般學科興趣。
需要改寫成 She is strongly interested in...。

exercises.original: His enthusiasm for architecture began at school.
exercises.zh: 他對建築的濃厚興趣始於求學時期。
exercises.upgrade: His strong interest in architecture began at school.

options.explanation: 適合中性描述長期興趣的起點。

exercises.original: The students' enthusiasm for the topic was clear from the number of questions they asked.
exercises.zh: 從學生提出很多問題可看出他們對主題有濃厚興趣。
exercises.upgrade: The students' strong interest in the topic was clear from the number of questions they asked.

options.explanation: 大量提問證明濃厚興趣，但未必需要更強的 passion。
若重點是急著提問也可，但這裡描述對 topic 的整體興趣。
意思變成「非常有趣的」，而且詞性結構不對。

falseSynonyms.zh: 快樂 ≠ 熱情 happiness 是整體愉快感受；enthusiasm 是對某事積極投入的熱情。
興趣 ≠ 完整熱情 interest 可以很平靜、被動；enthusiasm 通常更有能量。
動機 ≠ 熱情 motivation 是促使你採取行動的原因；enthusiasm 是你對事情的積極情緒和投入。
信心 ≠ 熱情 一個人可以很有信心但完全沒有熱情。
好奇 ≠ 熱忱 curiosity 是想知道更多；enthusiasm 則常包含積極投入。
高度相關，但不完全等同 excitement 可以短暫；enthusiasm 往往能持續並推動參與。
詞性陷阱 - enthusiasm = 名詞 - enthusiastic = 形容詞 - enthusiastically = 副詞
詞性不同 - passion = 名詞 - passionate = 形容詞 - passionately = 副詞
